column1: # The answers to the mutants no behavioural test kills (VARKA-265): dev/varka_pit_verdicts.py
# reads them into the verdicts report. One line per mutant, tab-separated: the class, the method,
# the line, the mutator and the first instruction index, as the report lists them, then the test
# that now kills it or why it changes no behaviour. A note that matches no open mutant fails the
# report, so a note leaves with the mutant it answered.
